a.title: The answer

a.text: The answer: By average turnaround time, finish minus arrival.

text.font-family: Source Sans 3, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

a.text: FIFO runs jobs in arrival order; with one long job in front the

text.font-family: Source Sans 3, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

a.text: short ones convoy behind it, 110 s instead of 50. It costs

text.font-family: Source Sans 3, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

a.text: nothing to compute and is blind to length.

a.title: The answer

text.font-family: Source Sans 3, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

a.text: The answer: Shortest first: SJF when everyone arrives together,

text.font-family: Source Sans 3, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

a.text: STCF (shortest remaining time, with preemption) when jobs arrive

text.font-family: Source Sans 3, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

a.text: at any time. The best possible turnaround; the price is that it

text.font-family: Source Sans 3, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

a.text: needs the lengths, and long jobs wait.

a.title: The answer

text.font-family: Source Sans 3, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

a.text: The answer: Response time, the wait for the first run. Round

text.font-family: Source Sans 3, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

a.text: robin gives every job a slice in turn: response 1 instead of 5

text.font-family: Source Sans 3, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

a.text: for three 5 s jobs. The price is turnaround 14 instead of 10, and

text.font-family: Source Sans 3, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

a.text: a switch per slice (1.5 µs here). Two families, and no rule wins

a.text: 4.1 Overlapping I/O: each CPU burst as a job

text.font-family: Source Sans 3, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

a.title: The answer

text.font-family: Source Sans 3, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

a.text: The answer: Treat each CPU burst as a job and run someone else

text.font-family: Source Sans 3, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

a.text: during the wait: overlap. 150 ms became 100 in the drawing, 157

text.font-family: Source Sans 3, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

a.text: became 136 measured. The price is that the scheduler must notice

text.font-family: Source Sans 3, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

a.text: every block and wake-up; the gain is that jobs that wait often
